description: PASS 47.1: state-generality audit of every Section 3 / Section 4 result

summary.verdict: G1-G4 and G6 pass on every state in the zoo: the Hoeffding formula, the cubic zeta_1 identity, the spectral zeta_2 identity, the two zeta_2 bounds and both bias laws are state-general. G5 fails off its ensemble by design, which is what makes the closed forms an ensemble-specific evaluation rather than a general result.
